text:
Alex: heads-up — console shows negative prefetch savings for tenant XYZ in staging, spotted while prepping demo
Maria: ah ok, repro steps?
Alex: go to /console/costs -> Tenant XYZ -> Prefetch credits card. sparkline dips below zero around 03:10
Sam: that timeframe was during the canary. could be double-count from router + sidecar
deploy-bot: Deployment started for econ-service-canary@v1.2.3
Jo: is this purely a viz issue (bad aggregation) or the backend emitting wrong numbers?
Prashant: my hunch: attribution duplication. router emits a prefetch event and the sidecar emits the same tokens; we added dedupe but sampling/cut windows can still double-count
Elaine: sales demo at 09:00 — can we hide negatives until it's fixed? looks really bad in slides
Maria: agree hide them + show an "estimated" badge. also add a tooltip explaining prefetch estimates
Sam: quick check: `SELECT count(*) FROM prefetch_events WHERE tenant='XYZ' AND ts BETWEEN 1728887800 AND 1728888200;` -> 142k (a lot)
Alex: thanks — I'll patch console to clamp prefetch savings floor at 0 and add the tooltip. low-risk frontend change
Jo: add telemetry flag `prefetch_credit_source` on events so we can trace router vs sidecar vs batcher. helps root cause
Prashant: will update router and sidecar emitters to include `source=router|sidecar|batcher` and event id for dedupe
Maria: timeline? we need the UI fix before the morning demo
Alex: I'll open a PR in the next 15m, canary the UI, prod in ~2h if no regressions
Elaine: please post a short note in the Statusboard and ping @sales so they don't run into the slide in the interim
Sam: separate ask: we should expose per-model/unit econ in the cost dashboard. current rollups hide which model SKUs dominated the savings
Prashant: agreed. add `model_sku` tag to econ events so dashboard can break down by model. will need ingestion/schema bump
Jo: UX suggestion: add a toggle on the cost panel "Include prefetch estimates" with an inline tooltip describing the estimation method and sample query
Maria: also surface an uncertainty badge (low/medium/high) based on sample rate and dedupe confidence
Alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/12345 — clamps negative values, adds pill "estimated", wires telemetry flag for follow-up
Maria: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded for econ-console@patch-1728888888
Sam: after canary, run `diff` queries on sampled vs full to confirm numbers look sane
Elaine: can we create an alert if prefetch credits > 50% of total savings for a tenant? that seems like a good signal for noisy attribution
Prashant: yes — adding rule to econ-alerts: `prefetch_fraction > 0.5` -> auto-tag and notify #eng-platform + owner
Jo: I'll sketch how the alert card should show contributing models and recent events for quick triage
Maria: good. next steps: Alex patches UI (in flight), Prashant updates emitters/schema, Sam validates queries, Jo designs alert card, Elaine pings sales about demo
Alex: will follow up in this thread with canary numbers and short TL;DR for ops
Maria: thanks all — if stable we'll close this out after postmortem, otherwise escalate into an incident channel
